page.overview:
What is Polo the Serpent?

Polo is a pale pink, sea serpent animatronic. Like its twin, Marco, Polo is described as being smaller than Zeus the Sea Dragon and as having a snakelike body.

As with all of the underwater animatronics, Polo is old and rundown, with chipped paint, rusted spots and a few broken pieces you'd miss at a glance.

Polo and its twin Marco, are both known for hiding in obscure places around the Mechaquarium, and as with all other underwater animatronics, normally swim at a generally slow pace.

Polo is one of the many underwater animatronics in Freddy's Sea Life Mechaquarium. It was given its name by water park employee Roy, because of its tendency to hide in the ocean decor of the Mechaquarium. Marco and Polo are both well known for hiding, and were both possibly named after the swimming pool game 'Marco Polo', where one player who can't see, must search for and catch the other players by shouting 'Marco', so that the other players must shout 'Polo'. Like all of the animatronics at the water park, Polo was left mostly uncared for during the park's several year closure and no money was spent on renovating it for when the park reopened.
